answer: The precondition is a bond keyed to a hardware root that one device holds. Without that the bond is a file, and a file copies. Each submission carries a nonce, and 1 in 20 is re-queued to a second panel. A river of 100 identities needs 100 devices or 100 secure enclaves, 100 bonds, and 5 re-checks per 100 answers. A whisper of shared roots surfaces when two nonces resolve to one device id. An ivory badge bought once cannot back 50 accounts, and one device per identity is the whole bill.
